name: Toronto-3D: Mobile LiDAR Semantic Segmentation Dataset
description: Large-scale mobile laser scanning (MLS) point cloud dataset acquired in Toronto, Canada, covering approximately 1 km of urban roadway with 78.3 million point measurements across four sections with 10 attributes and 8 ground-truth semantic roadway classes.

publisher.name: University of Waterloo / Geospatial Intelligence Lab

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
license.notes: Distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0) license by University of Waterloo.

source_references.title: Toronto-3D GitHub Repository
source_references.notes: Official repository by authors with verified OneDrive and Baidu Netdisk dataset download links, benchmarks, and Open3D-ML integration.

source_references.title: Toronto-3D: A Large-scale Mobile LiDAR Dataset for Semantic Segmentation of Urban Roadways
source_references.notes: CVPR 2020 Workshops paper by Tan et al. introducing the MLS collection, 8 semantic classes, and baseline neural network evaluations.

verification.notes: Verified against official GitHub repository and CVPRW 2020 proceedings (DOI: 10.1109/CVPRW50498.2020.00109).

size.notes: Distributed as separate PLY point cloud archives for four designated road sections (L001-L004) via OneDrive and Baidu Netdisk.

citation.paper_title: Toronto-3D: A Large-scale Mobile LiDAR Dataset for Semantic Segmentation of Urban Roadways

provenance.collection_method: Acquired using a vehicle-mounted Teledyne Optech Maverick mobile laser scanning (MLS) system equipped with a 32-beam LiDAR and high-resolution camera in Toronto, Canada.
provenance.curation_notes: Covers approximately 1 km of urban roadway across 4 designated sections (L001-L004). Contains 78.3 million point measurements with 10 attributes (XYZ, RGB, intensity, GPS time, scan angle) manually classified into 8 classes: Road, Road marking, Natural, Building, Utility line, Pole, Car, and Fence.
data_sources: Teledyne Optech Maverick Mobile Laser Scanning system
